state.subject: Room temperature complaints on floor 7
state.body: Since Saturday, guests on floor 7 keep reporting that their rooms stay at 27-28 C even with the thermostat set to 23 C. Could you check the optimization settings? We have a full house this weekend.

urgent_literal.instructions: Does the sender explicitly describe an immediate outage, imminent deadline or safety concern?

urgent_business.instructions: Is guest comfort currently affected for many rooms, or does the sender mention an upcoming high-occupancy period such as a full house?
